run_train_instruct_pix2pix: run the InstructPix2Pix fine-tuning script with pretrained model and dataset arguments
parse_training_arguments: parse CLI arguments for InstructPix2Pix training including dataset, batch size, learning rate, and validation settings
validate_trained_pipeline: validate the trained InstructPix2Pix pipeline by generating edited images from a prompt and original image
preprocess_training_dataset: preprocess a training dataset by resizing images, tokenizing edit prompts, and preparing pixel values for fine-tuning
save_and_push_model: save the fine-tuned InstructPix2Pix pipeline to disk and optionally push it to the Hugging Face Hub
